reason: Document A speaks to my worries directly: it promises in plain terms that every pledge comes back if the goal isn't met, it adds the $11,000 already pledged in writing, and it offers spending reports at the library. That leaves a $49,000 gap that feels reachable. Document B is full of placeholders, puts the refund promise in brackets, and asks for $60,000, so it feels unfinished and riskier to someone who just gave $200 to the hospital fund.
